result.title: From Manufacturing Event Logs to Simulation: Enabling SMEs with Agentic AI for SimPy Simulation Generation
result.comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Winter Simulation Conference 2026 Glasgow, Scotland
result.summary: High expertise and cost barriers exclude small and medium-sized enterprises from discrete-event simulation (DES). We introduce GenAI4SimPy, a multi-agent framework powered by Qwen 3.6 (27B), an open-weight large language model, that automates end-to-end DES generation from manufacturing event logs to executable SimPy models through tool-augmented reasoning and human-in-the-loop validation. Evaluated on three execution blocks from a public smart factory dataset, the framework achieved a mean absolute percentage error of 7.9\% and coverage of failure rate for all three blocks and of throughput for two of three. A fidelity paradox was observed: accurate process-level parameters did not ensure system-level behavioral fidelity, with flow-time and throughput errors driven by misinterpreted observation-window truncation and absent system-level calibration. These results demonstrate that local open-weight models can perform DES generation at accuracy comparable to cloud-based alternatives, while identifying parameter extraction as necessary but insufficient for behavioral validity. Source code and results are available at https://github.com/RaikoPipe/genai4simpy

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GenAI4SimPy 多智能体框架，用开源权重模型从制造事件日志自动生成可执行的 SimPy 离散事件仿真模型，并报告参数精度与系统级行为保真度不一致的现象。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究面向工业事件日志到仿真代码的生成，不涉及视觉或多模态内部状态、证据筛选与推理停止决策；「参数准确不等于行为保真」虽可与局部正确性混淆类比，但缺少可核查的具体方法线索，故排除。
